verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

segments.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

verses.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

segments.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

verses.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

segments.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

verses.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

segments.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

verses.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

segments.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

verses.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.

segments.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.

verses.text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

segments.text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

verses.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.

segments.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.

verses.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

segments.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

verses.text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

segments.text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

verses.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.

segments.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
